description_en: Queries the list of versions of a template
description_zh: 通过查询指定模板获取模板的版本列表详情
name: ListTemplateVersions

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of results to be returned in a single call when NextToken is used for the query.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh:
使用NextToken方式查询时，每次最多返回的结果数。

取值范围：1~100。

默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The template ID. This parameter applies to shared and private templates
parameters.help_zh: 模板ID。支持共享模板和私有模板
parameters.name: template_id
